title: IDF Strikes Five More Towns Overnight; Drone Explodes Over al-Mansouri
detail: The Israeli military targeted Hadatha, al-Qantara, al-Mansouri, Ali al-Taher, and Kfar Remman overnight, while Israeli forces burned, bulldozed, and detonated land and houses in Bouyout al-Siyed, Majdalzoun, Serbine, Bani Hayan, al-Khiam, and Markaba. Lebanon's National News Agency said an Israeli drone exploded over al-Mansouri. A fire that erupted near Deir Mimas along the Litani River spread toward al-Khardali and Marjayoun, again requiring civil defense intervention.

media.caption: South Lebanon under renewed Israeli strikes and demolitions, Aug 26, 2026

title: 70-Member UAE Business Delegation Arrives in Beirut
detail: A roughly 70-member Emirati business delegation began a two-day visit to Lebanon to sign agreements with the Lebanese private sector, hosted by the Lebanese Economic Organizations umbrella group. The delegation is proposing to help develop and manage services at Beirut's airport, seaports, and border crossings, alongside potential partnerships on customs systems and oil facilities — part of a wider Gulf push to court Lebanese investment amid the country's financial collapse and ongoing conflict in the south.

media.caption: UAE business delegation arrives in Beirut to sign private-sector agreements
